verdict.rationale: Stripe documents Smart Retries, which automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments to prevent involuntary churn. Its recovery analytics report payment failure and recovery rates, which covers the 'measurably recovers' part of the story. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the retry cadence is ML- or schedule-optimized (only implied by the 'Smart' name), quantified recovery outcomes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
